notes:
**The plain sentence said "buy a call" about a rule that writes one.** The one line on the build screen a beginner can act on read the rule's direction - which is forced long for options so the leg can decide the side. A written option now says what it actually is: sell, collect the premium, keep it if the index stays below the strike (or above, for a put) - and says this is the side whose loss has no limit.

**The live screen watching that rule had the same fault in three places.** A written call's profit was painted red, the line said "Bought", and the stop and target were described as the opposite of where they were really placed.

**A share card could claim a profit the trade did not make** - the number that leaves the app into a WhatsApp group was before costs. So were the scalper strip, the realised P&L statement and the basket preview. All four now count what trading costs.
